tools.natal_chart: Western astrology natal chart (birth chart, horoscope): planets in zodiac signs and houses, sun sign, moon sign and rising sign (ascendant), MC, aspects and a summary. ($0.06 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.transits: Western astrology transits: the transits to a natal chart at a moment, and the exact dates transiting aspects perfect over a window of up to a year. ($0.08 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.synastry: Western astrology synastry (relationship compatibility): compare two birth charts with cross-aspects, house overlays both ways and composite midpoints. ($0.12 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.nakshatras: Vedic astrology nakshatras: the sidereal nakshatra, pada and lord of every graha, plus the janma nakshatra with gana, yoni, nadi and varna. ($0.02 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.panchang: Vedic astrology panchang (Hindu calendar) for a day and place: tithi, vara, nakshatra, yoga and karana with their exact end times, plus sunrise and sunset. ($0.02 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.kundli: Vedic astrology birth chart (kundli, Jyotish horoscope, D1 and D9): lagna and the nine grahas with rashi, nakshatra, pada, house, dignity and combustion. ($0.15 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.kundli_full: Vedic astrology full kundli: all 16 Shodashavarga divisional charts, D1 to D60 (navamsa, dasamsa...), by Parashara's rules. ($0.32 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.vimshottari_dasha: Vedic astrology dasha periods: the Vimshottari maha, antar and pratyantar dashas with exact dates, the balance at birth and the periods running now. ($0.10 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.doshas: Vedic astrology doshas: check Manglik (Kuja), Kaal Sarp and Sade Sati / Dhaiya, each with the rule applied and the relevant dates. ($0.15 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.gun_milan: Vedic astrology kundli matching (horoscope matching, marriage compatibility): 36-point Ashtakoota Gun Milan with all 8 kootas and reasons, plus dosha and Manglik checks. ($0.25 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)
tools.vedic_report: Vedic astrology report in one call: kundli, Vimshottari dashas, doshas and the birth panchang. ($0.50 over REST; first 3 calls free over MCP)

trust: Positions from NASA/JPL DE440 (NASA/JPL), 1800-01-01..2200-01-01, via Skyfield: geocentric apparent, true equinox of date, IAU 2006/2000A.
Historical time zones resolved for you (IANA tz database, DST of the era, Local Mean Time); ambiguous or non-existent local times are flagged, never guessed.
Deterministic, no LLM: same input -> same bytes. Every response carries meta.input_sha256 and meta.result_sha256 (also as X-Input-SHA256 / X-Result-SHA256 headers); POST /v1/verify recomputes one.
Every convention is in the response: ayanamsa (name, true and mean value), house system, orbs, node type, dasha year length, dosha and koota rule sets.
Cross-validated against an independent engine (XALEN, Apache-2.0): ayanamsas agree to < 0.1", 15/16 divisional charts identically, all 11 house systems in structure.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.payment: Pay per call with **x402** (USDC on Base or Solana) or **MPP** (Tempo: OUSD or USDC.e). No account, no API key. First 3 calls free per client on the five $0.01-0.02 routes (any tool over MCP); every other route is always paid.
